scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts && esbuild dist/handler.js dist/vcdb_gateway.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outdir=dist/bundle --format=esm --external:@aws-sdk/*
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist/bundle && zip -r ../../function.zip .
scripts.deploy: npm run package && cd ../infra && terraform apply -auto-approve
